items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps oily, sensitive-feeling skin clean without stripping it.
A light mattifying gel with niacinamide 4% that adds moisture and helps shine look more controlled without feeling heavy.
A mineral SPF 50 suits fair, sensitive-feeling skin and protects daily so tone and texture look more even over time.

response.routine_note: I left out the 30% peel because it is a very strong exfoliant for skin that reads as oily and sensitive and is new to active products, so start with this simple cleanse, moisturize and SPF routine, using SPF every morning. If texture still bothers you after several weeks, a gentler exfoliant can be added slowly, and a dermatologist can advise on stronger peels.
